description: This file defines the interface for the sip_svc driver in Zephyr, including callback types, API structure, and syscall wrappers for supervisory calls, transaction management, and asynchronous response handling.

classes.name: svc_driver_api
classes.description: Structure containing function pointers for sip_svc driver API callbacks.

methods.name: z_impl_sip_supervisory_call
methods.description: Implementation of the supervisory call function that executes the smc/hvc call.

methods.name: z_impl_sip_svc_plat_func_id_valid
methods.description: Checks if the function id is valid for a supervisory call.

methods.name: z_impl_sip_svc_plat_format_trans_id
methods.description: Generates a transaction id from client and transaction indices.

methods.name: z_impl_sip_svc_plat_get_trans_idx
methods.description: Retrieves client transaction id from a transaction id.

methods.name: z_impl_sip_svc_plat_update_trans_id
methods.description: Updates the transaction id in a sip_svc_request.

methods.name: z_impl_sip_svc_plat_get_error_code
methods.description: Retrieves error code from arm_smccc_res response.

methods.name: z_impl_sip_svc_plat_async_res_req
methods.description: Sets arguments for polling supervisory call for async response.

methods.name: z_impl_sip_svc_plat_async_res_res
methods.description: Checks polling response and retrieves size and transaction id.

methods.name: z_impl_sip_svc_plat_free_async_memory
methods.description: Frees command buffer used for async packet.
